measures.item: friend's tripod head where the plate mounts
measures.what: Is it a quick-release clamp (a slot with a locking lever) or a flat platform with a screw sticking up out of it? Describe it, and measure the width and depth of the slot/opening the plate goes into, and how thick a plate it would take.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: Overall length from the underside of the head to the tip of the thread
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head)

measures.what: Head diameter and head height (thickness of the head)
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head)

measures.what: Depth of the threaded hole in the bottom of the camera
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: Depth of the slot: from the top edge of the angled jaws straight down to the floor of the channel, and the gap measured across between the two jaws at the very top vs. down at the floor
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: How long a plate it will take front-to-back (the length of the slot / how far a plate can slide in)
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: Confirm the thread: measure across the threads (major diameter) and say how much of the 10 mm under the head is threaded vs. plain shank
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head)

measures.what: Is there a flat floor at the bottom of the slot, or is the middle open/hollow? Is there a pin or stop at one end?
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: Calipers, as exactly as you can: the length of the threaded part measured from the underside of the head to the tip, and the width across the head
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head)

measures.what: Calipers or a thin stick: how deep the 1/4-20 threaded hole in the bottom of the camera is, from the camera's base surface to the bottom of the hole
measures.reply: camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

limitations.wanted: Measure the borrowed tripod's jaw taper with a protractor (or by printing and test-fitting the three angle gauges) and measure the camera's 1/4-20 socket depth directly
limitations.blocked_by: The person could not report measurements or print results for these — repeated attempts came back as generic answers, so nothing could be confirmed or iterated on
limitations.why: The jaw taper is the one dimension that decides whether the plate locks into the clamp or rocks, and the socket depth decides whether the salvaged bolt bottoms out before the camera seats flat. Both had to fall back on the Arca-Swiss standard (38 deg) and a typical socket depth, so both are flagged as guesses with a fit check in the manual
